# defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a DefectDojo CI/CD infrastructure object by ID, or by name and type, for example for an engagement's `cicd_build_server_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure" "jenkins" {
  name                = "Jenkins"
  infrastructure_type = "build_server"
}

data "defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure" "by_id" {
  id = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the object to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `infrastructure_type` (String) The type of the object: `scm_server`, `build_server` or `orchestration`. It narrows a lookup by `name`, and can only be set with `name`.
- `name` (String) The name of the object to look up, compared exactly. Names are unique within a type: set `infrastructure_type` too when objects of several types have the name. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the object; null for users without the view or change permission for CI/CD infrastructure.
- `url` (String) The URL of the tool; null for users without the view or change permission for CI/CD infrastructure.
